ruleExplorerComputerScience.title: Computer Laboratory Access Rule
ruleExplorerComputerScience.instructions: Toggle the two conditions to see when entry is granted.
ruleExplorerComputerScience.accessibilityLabel: Computer laboratory access AND rule explorer
ruleExplorerComputerScience.fallbackText: Entry is granted only when both a valid student ID card and teacher permission are present.
hints: Set both inputs to Present / Granted to see Output = 1.

output.explanationFalse: At least one required condition is missing.

ruleExplorerChemistry.title: Combustion Conditions (Fire Triangle)
ruleExplorerChemistry.instructions: Toggle Fuel, Oxygen, and Heat to test when combustion can occur.
ruleExplorerChemistry.fallbackText: Combustion requires Fuel, Oxygen, and Heat above ignition temperature.

output.explanationTrue: All three fire triangle requirements are satisfied.
output.explanationFalse: Removing any one side of the fire triangle prevents combustion.

codePlaygroundPython.title: Python Pass/Retry Check
codePlaygroundPython.instructions: Run the Python snippet and try changing the input mark.
codePlaygroundPython.fallbackText: When mark >= 50 the program prints Pass; otherwise it prints Retry.

codePlaygroundPseudocode.title: Cambridge Pseudocode Accumulator Loop
codePlaygroundPseudocode.instructions: Run the FOR loop to compute the sum of 1 to 5.
codePlaygroundPseudocode.fallbackText: Summing 1 through 5 in a FOR loop outputs 15.
codePlaygroundPseudocode.pseudocodeStarter:
Total ← 0
FOR Count ← 1 TO 5
    Total ← Total + Count
NEXT Count
OUTPUT Total

codePlaygroundSql.title: Read-Only Stock Filter Query
codePlaygroundSql.instructions: Run the SELECT query to filter items with Quantity < 6.
codePlaygroundSql.fallbackText: SELECT ItemName, Price FROM Stock WHERE Quantity < 6 lists low-stock items.
codePlaygroundSql.sqlStarter:
SELECT ItemName, Price
FROM Stock
WHERE Quantity < 6
ORDER BY Price DESC;

constructionLabBooleanCircuit.title: Boolean Circuit Construction Lab
constructionLabBooleanCircuit.instructions: Wire logic gates and toggle inputs A and B to verify the circuit output.
constructionLabBooleanCircuit.fallbackText: Inspect the truth table of AND, OR, and NOT logic gates.
